blocks.text: Satrahvin (17th) sadi ke shuru mein bohat se scientists ne bohat chhoti cheezon ko parhne ke liye microscope istemal karna shuru kiya. 1665 mein English scientist Robert Hooke ne oak darakht ke cork ka ek patla tukra microscope ke neeche dekha. Usne dekha ke cork "bohat se chhote dabbon" (little boxes) se bana hai. Hooke ne oak ke tanay aur jar ke tukre bhi dekhe aur paya ke woh bhi aise hi chhote dabbon se bane hain. Usne nateeja nikala ke poday ke hisse khanon (compartments) se bane hain, aur in khanon ka naam "cellulae" rakha.

blocks.alt: Baen: Robert Hooke ki compound microscope ka saada khaaka, peetal ki lambi tube jis ke oopar eyepiece aur neeche objective lens, stand par aur neeche cork ka tukra. Daen: gol manzar jo moti deewaron wale dabba-numa cells se bhara hai; yeh woh chhote dabbe (cells) hain jo Hooke ne 1665 mein cork mein dekhe aur unhein cellulae kaha.
blocks.caption: Robert Hooke ki microscope aur cork mein dekhe gaye chhote khane (Figure 3.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Woh daryaften (discoveries) jo cell theory tak le gayin

blocks.text: In mutalion ke baad biologists ne cells ke baare mein maloomat ko tarteeb (order) dena shuru kiya. Schleiden, Schwann aur Virchow ke mushahide mila kar cells ke baare mein ek bunyadi nazariya (theory) bana, jise cell theory kehte hain. Is ke teen lazmi (essential) nuqte hain.

blocks.title: Cell theory
blocks.text: 1. Tamam jandar ek ya zyada cells se bane hain. 2. Cells kisi jandar mein banawat (structure) aur kaam (function) ki bunyadi ikai hain. 3. Cells sirf pehle se maujood cells ki taqseem (division) se bante hain.
Cell theory ki tasdeeq kai mushahidon aur tajurbon (experiments) se ki ja sakti hai.

items: Light microscopes aur electron microscopes se scientists cell ki banawat dekhte hain aur thos (tangible) saboot paate hain ke cells waqai tamam jandaron ki banawat ki ikai hain.

Live-cell imaging aur genetic studies jaisi techniques se scientists dekh sakte hain ke cells kaise replicate hote aur naye cells banate hain. Yeh techniques is usool ki tasdeeq karti hain ke tamam cells pehle se maujood cells se aate hain.
DNA sequencing jaisi techniques dikhati hain ke cells mushtarak (shared) genetic material aur metabolic pathways rakhte hain, jo is khayal ko mazboot karta hai ke cell zindagi ki bunyadi ikai hai.
Cell culture studies aur tissue engineering jaise tajurbe cell ki numu, differentiation aur afzaish dikha kar cell theory ki tasdeeq karte hain.

blocks.text: Cell theory aam taur par tasleem-shuda (accepted) hai, magar kuch qabil-e-zikr istisnaat hain.

items: Viruses cell theory ko challenge karte hain kyunke woh cells se nahin bane aur zindagi ke amal khud nahin kar sakte. Replicate hone ke liye unhen host cell chahiye, aur bohat se scientists unhen zinda aur ghair-zinda ki sarhad par rakhte hain. Isi tarah prions aur viroids jandar ki khususiyat dikhate hain magar cells se nahin bane; woh sirf DNA, RNA ya proteins se bane hain.

Eukaryotic organelles mitochondria aur chloroplasts apna DNA rakhte hain aur cell ke nucleus se azaad ho kar replicate kar sakte hain. Is se lagta hai ke woh azaad rehne wale prokaryotic cells se nikle hon ge.

Kuch jandaron, jaise kuch fungi aur algae, mein aisi banawat hoti hai jahan ek mushtarak cytoplasm mein kai nuclei saath rehte hain. Yeh riwayati cell theory ke mutabiq alag-alag cell ki hadon ko dhundla kar deti hain.
Vertebrates ke muscle cells (myocytes) mil kar kai nuclei wale fibres bana sakte hain, jo pecheeda tissues mein ek cell ko bunyadi ikai manne ke tasawwur ko challenge karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Cell theory ke teen nuqte batayen, phir har ek ki himayat (support) mein ek mushahida aur theory ko challenge karne wala ek istisna batayen.
blocks.explanation: Nuqte: tamam jandar cells se bane hain; cell banawat aur kaam ki ikai hai; cells sirf pehle se maujood cells se aate hain. Himayat: microscopy har jandar mein cells dikhati hai; live-cell imaging cells ko cells se taqseem hote dikhati hai; DNA sequencing mushtarak genetic material dikhati hai. Istisnaat: viruses, prions aur viroids cells nahin; mitochondria aur chloroplasts khud replicate hote hain; kai nuclei wale fungi, algae aur jure hue muscle fibres.

items: Hooke (1665) ne cork mein cellulae dekhe; Leeuwenhoek ne zinda cells dekhe; Brown ne nucleus dhunda; Schleiden (poday) aur Schwann (janwar) ne kaha jandar cells se bane hain; Virchow ne kaha cells cells se aate hain; Pasteur ne sabit kiya.
Cell theory: tamam jandar cells se bane hain; cell banawat aur kaam ki ikai hai; cells sirf pehle se maujood cells se bante hain.

Tasdeeq microscopy, live-cell imaging, DNA sequencing aur cell culture se; istisnaat mein viruses, prions, viroids, khud replicate hone wale mitochondria aur chloroplasts, kai nuclei wali banawat aur jure hue muscle fibres shamil hain.
